dropdowns.label: The Internal sensitivity label inherits all the settings from the Confidential label.
Users must provide justification if they change the label of content from Confidential/Internal to Confidential/External.
Content that has the Confidential/External label applied will retain the encryption settings if the sensitivity label is removed from the label policy.

explanation: The Internal label inherits settings from Confidential, justification is required for label changes, but encryption settings do not persist if the label is removed.
